title: Oracle cost of the learner
statement: For any natural numbers $n,\ell,m$, target function on $\{\pm1\}^n$, and outcome in the support of running the low-degree polynomial learner with $m$ random examples on that target, the outcome's random-example cost is $m$ and its membership-query cost is zero.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n, ℓ, and m
outcome belongs to the support of the learner's run with cost
